title: AlgMortar: a fully algebraic multiscale mortar preconditioner
summary: The solution of large-scale symmetric positive definite (SPD) linear systems arising from discretizations of second-order elliptic equations is challenging, especially in applications with highly heterogeneous coefficients, such as flow in porous media, which can lead to severely ill-conditioned systems. In this context, multiscale methods have recently been used to accelerate Krylov subspace methods, owing to their favorable parallel scalability.
